auxiliary_geometry.policy: Only selected raw contours imported; original metrics and layout retained. Signatures and provenance declarations are necessary, not sufficient; original-static endpoint/intermediate verification remains required.

shared_control_canonicalization.corner_policy: 15-degree salient tangent changes, equal count across every master, cyclic geometric matching.

exact_phantom_metrics.policy: Exact integer local hats from original metric-owner phantoms; every nonphantom outline delta retained.

exact_gpos_anchors.policy: Original integer Anchor grids before rounding/dedup; semantic paths before any conditional lookup cloning. Existing shared-store prefixes preserved.
exact_gpos_anchors.limits: Non-anchor ValueRecords and incomplete availability grids are unchanged.

gvar_precision: Exact IUP compression (zero coordinate-error tolerance); integer tuple encoding remains independently checked.

horizontal_metrics.policy: Complete advance and bearing phantom metrics in gvar; optional HVAR omitted to preserve composite-origin deltas in rasterizers.

source_math_contract.interpolation: Exact local piecewise-linear tensor hats; integer endpoint and style-interaction deltas.
source_math_contract.plain_field_policy: All non-MathValueRecord fields must be identical across masters.

math_variations.interpolation: Exact local piecewise-linear tensor hats; integer endpoint and style-interaction deltas.
math_variations.plain_field_policy: All non-MathValueRecord fields must be identical across masters.

sparse_anchor_lookup_policy.policy: Whole lookup groups and every Feature index redirected, preserving global execution order.
